summary.text: Robert Qua is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Strafford 9, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An educator, Qua says he has worked in special education in public schools for his entire career.

paragraphs.text: Robert Qua earned a high school diploma from Great Bridge High School, a bachelor's degree from Florida State University in 2007, and a graduate degree from the University of Virginia in 2014.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Qua said he grew up as a Navy child who moved every few years, that he and his wife chose New Hampshire more than a decade ago, and that he is running to represent Rochester's Sixth Ward.
He said he has served as a special educator in public schools for more than fifteen years and has been an educational leader for the last seven.

Qua listed three key campaign messages in the survey: preserving what he called the New Hampshire Advantage of limited government and low taxes, passing "Defend the Guard" legislation, and expanding school choice.
He also named reducing government spending, protecting property rights including gun rights, and reducing regulatory barriers for businesses and workers as policy interests.
